name: Vol-of-vol shock fade — dvol acceleration mean-reversion (1h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: not the dvol LEVEL (covered by dvol-spike specs) but its SECOND derivative — vol-of-vol. A sharp UP-acceleration in dvol is the options market panic-repricing convexity faster than spot warrants; VOV spikes are the most transient part of the vol surface (Du 2025, JFM, vol-of-vol risk premium) and revert within hours-to-days because the repricing overshoots the actual information. We proxy the acceleration by requiring dvol to sit above a fitted level WHILE realized vol has NOT yet expanded (vol_realized below a fitted ceiling) — i.e. implied is racing ahead of realized, the signature of a VOV overshoot — AND recent price return is modestly negative (the panic dip we fade). The other side is the gamma-scalping desks and dealers who must chase the surface in real time and mechanically bid vol-of-vol during the shock; they are forced buyers at the wrong price and we fade them with a spot long into the reversion. Distinct from dvol-spike-capitulation (which trades the LEVEL extreme) — here even a mid-level dvol can fire if implied is racing ahead of a still-calm realized. Exit: vol_realized crosses UP (realized finally catches up -> the overshoot resolved, thesis done) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: replace the implied-ahead-of-realized trigger with a dvol LEVEL threshold only — if the static level does as well, the acceleration (VOV) thesis is unsupported and this is a dvol-spike re-skin. DISCONFIRMER 2: acceleration and level correlate at extremes — if the two legs fire on the same bars >80% of the time there is no orthogonal signal. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points -> paper-only.
catalyst: implied vol racing ahead of a still-calm realized — a vol-of-vol overshoot to fade
